_about: Shared fixtures for surpyval/tests/reference; written by scripts/reference/make_fixtures.py. Null is a missing value (or an unbounded interval end).

aml.source: R survival::aml (maintained = 1 for x == 'Maintained'); status 1 is a death

bladder2.source: R survival::bladder2 (Wei, Lin and Weissfeld 1989): start-stop rows of each subject's first four recurrences; event 1 is a recurrence

competing.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.competing (rng 3794); cause 0 is censored

cure_regression.source: simulated by reference_r_mixture_cure.R (seed 20261111): 400 units, some never fail; event 1 is a failure, entry a late-entry age

heart.source: surpyval.datasets.load_heart_transplants; R survival::heart (start-stop form, c = 1 - event)

ic_current_status.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.ic_current_status (rng 3802): current status; l = 0 left censored at u, u null (Inf) right censored at l

ic_mixed.source: simulated by reference_r_interval_cox.R (seed 20261113): 300 interval-censored Weibull PH lives; l = 0 left censored, u null (Inf) right censored, l == u exact; er_time and er_event the same lives exact or right censored

ic_wide_narrow.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.ic_wide_narrow (rng 3803): years in [left, right], exact where equal, right null (Inf) right censored, left = 0 from the origin

interval.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.interval (rng 3793); left == right is exact, left == 0 is left censored at right, right null is right censored at left

kidney.source: surpyval.datasets.load_kidney; R survival::kidney (female = sex == 2, c = 1 - status)

lung.source: surpyval.datasets.load_lung; R survival::lung with status recoded to SurPyval's flag (c = 2 - status)

mettas_zhao.source: surpyval.datasets.load_mettas_and_zhao (recurrent events on six systems; c = 1 marks the end of observation)

mgus2_multistate.source: surpyval.datasets.load_mgus2(spells=True); R survival::mgus2 as illness-death spells (state and e: 1 mgus, 2 pcm, 3 death; e null where the spell is censored); z1 = (age - 70) / 10, male 1 for a man

mgus2_pyears.source: surpyval.datasets.load_mgus2(); R survival::mgus2, one row per patient: age at diagnosis and dxyr (years), futime (months), death 1 for a death, male 1 for a man; tl a late entry made for the tests, futime %/% 3 months for every fourth id (id %% 4 == 0) and 0 otherwise

multistate.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.multistate (rng 3800): spells of an illness-death model with recovery, delayed entry and ties (state and e: 1 healthy, 2 ill, 3 dead; e null where the spell is censored)

multistate_panel.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.multistate_panel (rng 3801): a four-state Markov model seen at visits (state 1 well, 2 mild, 3 severe, 4 dead, 99 alive in an unseen state; obstype 1 a visit, 3 an exactly timed death; male multiplies every intensity by exp(0.4); w has no effect)

no_data.source: none: a design calculation (a sample size or a power) from the arguments in its call alone

ovarian.source: R survival::ovarian; fustat 1 is a death

pbc.source: surpyval.datasets.load_pbc2, first row per patient (the 312 trial patients at baseline); cause 0 censored, 1 transplant, 2 death

prediction_continuous.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.prediction (rng 3795); predictions S(t | z) = exp(-(exp(0.4 z) t / 10)^1.3) at 'times'

prediction_ties.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.prediction (rng 3795); predictions S(t | z) = exp(-(exp(0.4 z) t / 10)^1.3) at 'times'

rank_regression.source: made up for reference_r_weibullr.R: ten lifetimes; c_type2 censors the last four at 126 (x_type2), c_mixed makes 82 and 172 suspensions

recurrent_groups.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.recurrent_groups (rng 3798); event 1 is an event, 0 the end of observation

recurrent_groups_ties.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.recurrent_groups (rng 3799); event 1 is an event, 0 the end of observation

separation.source: seeded synthetic, make_fixtures.separation (rng 3798); every event has z1 = 1

veteran.source: R survival::veteran; status 1 is a death; celltype is R's factor code (1 squamous, 2 smallcell, 3 adeno, 4 large)
